text: The first portable implementation passed 90 group tests on JVM and 90 on JS. A bounded hot-loop improvement is undergoing final verification and held-out calibration. Implemented total refusal of unsupported designs, subject-bound exact/Monte Carlo plans, identity-corrected pointwise p-values, fixed-precision or equal-subject score, null-center inversion, resource admission and identified failures. Native build reuses its already-pinned resample4s core 6bc4172 directly. Generic random streams remain upstream; no Multivar upgrade or duplicated random kernel. The initial Multivar action integration was declined because the native pin predates that API and its adoption would widen dependency scope. Protocol amendment predates calibration; no statistical thresholds were tuned.
